name: 📝 口语模考·迎新 08-20
desc: 2026-08-20 口语模考 Task 1 原题 7 句（迎新咨询台主题）· 反复听/慢读/分块/录音评分 · 这场你错在:听错(gym→dream/tasty meal→terrace)、漏词(get to know)、整句崩(dormitory hall)

items.en: Welcome to the Student Information booth.
items.zh: 欢迎来到学生信息咨询台。

items.en: Campus orientation is in the gym.
items.zh: 校园迎新在体育馆进行。

items.en: Our cafeteria is known for its tasty meal options.
items.zh: 我们的食堂以美味的餐食选择而闻名。

items.en: Let us direct you to your assigned dormitory hall.
items.zh: 让我们带你去你分配到的宿舍楼。

items.en: Use the library for research and to focus on your studies.
items.zh: 利用图书馆做研究、专注于你的学业。
chunks: and to focus on your studies

items.en: We recommend visiting the Student Center to learn about clubs and activities.
items.zh: 我们建议去学生中心了解社团和活动。
chunks: to learn about clubs and activities

items.en: Before your courses begin, take time to explore and get to know the facilities.
items.zh: 在课程开始前，花点时间去探索、熟悉各项设施。
chunks: and get to know the facilities
